definitions.explanation: The property of resisting water penetration or damage from water. Used as a noun or as a modifier (耐水の, 耐水性) to describe materials, products, and coatings that withstand water.

examples.japanese: {耐水|たいすい}{性|せい}のある{素材|そざい}。
この{時計|とけい}は{耐水|たいすい}{仕様|しよう}だ。
examples.english: This watch has a waterproof specification.

examples.japanese: {耐水|たいすい}ペーパーで{仕上|しあ}げを{磨|みが}くと、{表面|ひょうめん}がなめらかになる。
examples.english: Polishing the finish with waterproof sandpaper makes the surface smooth.

notes:
Composed of {耐|たい} (resistant, enduring) + {水|すい} (water). Part of the productive {耐|たい}〜 pattern for describing resistance to various conditions.

USAGE:
{耐水|たいすい} is commonly used as a compound modifier: {耐水|たいすい}{性|せい} (water resistance as a property), {耐水|たいすい}{加工|かこう} (waterproof treatment), {耐水|たいすい}ペーパー (waterproof sandpaper). It is distinct from {防水|ぼうすい} (waterproof) in that {耐水|たいすい} emphasizes resistance or durability against water, while {防水|ぼうすい} emphasizes preventing water from entering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐水|たいすい}{性|せい}: water resistance (as a property)
- {耐水|たいすい}{加工|かこう}: waterproofing treatment
- {耐水|たいすい}ペーパー: waterproof sandpaper (wet-dry sandpaper)
- {耐水|たいすい}{圧|あつ}: water pressure resistance rating
- {耐水|たいすい}{塗料|とりょう}: water-resistant paint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {防水|ぼうすい}: waterproof — focuses on blocking water from entering; often used for coatings, cases, and gear
- {撥水|はっすい}: water-repellent — causes water to bead up and roll off the surface
- {耐熱|たいねつ}: heat-resistant — same {耐|たい}〜 pattern applied to heat
- {耐久|たいきゅう}: durable — resistance to wear and degradation over time
